$comment: Per-shot settings for tools/photo/clean_lightbox.py. Coordinates are pixels in the oriented original. F01 GCD detail (A6): the right temple at the hinge, close, from the front right. The engraved wordmark and old emblem come off stroke by stroke, by frequency-selective reconstruction (rows rebuilt along the temple streaked the tortoise). The GCD is placed with tools/photo/temple_gcd.py, the old print as a ruler: its ends lie 26.1 and 42.5 mm from the hinge (the 3D model on IMG_3556; a side view, IMG_3559, gives 25.2 to 26 and 40 to 41). The hinge line slants across the face as on the side drawing. The first placement, from the print's proportions, drew the GCD a fifth too short and 2 mm too far from the hinge.

lenses.name: far lens (wearer's left), cut by the edge

marks.name: engraved wordmark and old emblem, near temple (inset from the temple's edges, which the stroke detector would otherwise take for strokes)
